enums.name: SceneRevealPolicy
enums.doc: When a load that is ready to show is revealed: the new scene shows and its game starts.

functions.name: EstimatedSecondsRemaining
functions.doc: The estimate of the seconds until the new scene is ready to show, at the last frame the load ran. 0 once it is ready, and from the frame a pauseWorldDrawing load resumes the world.

functions.name: IsLoading
functions.doc: True from Load until the newest load is revealed, fails or is cancelled. A load that native code started counts too.

functions.name: IsProgressShown
functions.doc: True from the frame the load has run 1 s with an estimated total of 2.5 s or more, and it stays true. A shorter load stays false: a game can skip the bar for it.

functions.name: IsReadyToShow
functions.doc: True from the frame the new scene is ready to show: it is in the world, the work it needs is done, and Progress is 1.

functions.name: Load
functions.doc: Replaces the shown scene with `scene`, a .scene file relative to the project's asset root. The load starts at the next frame boundary, never inside a system. A newer Load cancels this one, and the functions then refuse this operation. `pauseWorldDrawing` pauses the world until the scene has drawn complete frames, or until the load fails or a newer Load without `pauseWorldDrawing` cancels it (SceneLoadRequest::PauseWorldDrawing).

functions.name: Progress
functions.doc: The bar of a loading screen, 0 to 1. It never goes down, rises at most 0.1 in any 250 ms before the load is ready to show, and is 1 from then on.

functions.name: Reveal
functions.doc: Reveals a WhenGameReleases load: in the frame it is ready when the call comes before that, else at the next frame boundary. It does nothing for an AtReady load and for a load that was revealed, failed or was cancelled.

records.name: SceneLoadOperation
records.doc: One scene load that a script started. Load returns it, and the other functions read it.
